search.description: Search for a literal substring in the contents of a file

path.description: The path to the file to search

match.description: Search for a regex pattern in the contents of a file

query.description: The regex pattern to search for

path.description: The path to the file to search

glob.description: List files with a glob pattern

pattern.description: The glob pattern to search for

ls.description: List the contents of a directory

path.description: The path to the directory to list

which.description: Find the path of a command in the PATH

command.description: The GitHub CLI command to run

read.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

edit.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits.

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

write.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file
